contents.text:
I can’t directly modify messages or add reactions with the tools I have (weather and time). But I can guide you on how to add a thumbs up emoji to msg_12345 on your platform.

 Quick steps by platform:
- Slack: Open the message, click Add reaction (the smiley face), and choose 👍.
- Discord: Hover over or click the message, click the emoji button, and select 👍 (or type :thumbsup:).
- WhatsApp: Long-press the message, then tap the emoji row and select 👍.
- iMessage: Tap and hold the message, then select the thumbs up reaction.
- Google Chat / other chat apps: Look for a “Add reaction” or emoji option on the message and pick 👍.

If you tell me which platform msg_12345 is on, I can give you exact steps. I can also help with weather or current time if you’d like.
